omission_audit.source_scope: Actual official SI PDF pp.S1-S21, visually checked Table S2 p.S14 and prior source renders; no main-text PDF located in workspace or Downloads by DOI/title-related filename.
omission_audit.table_coverage: All eight Table S2 rows and all six numerical property columns already admitted: 48 values plus 48 SDs. None rejected for method dependence alone.
omission_audit.normalization_disposition: Source-reported specific strength, modulus and electrical conductivity are retained without fabricating density; absolute thermal conductivity is retained with its measurement conditions. Missing mass-normalization formula limits interpretation, not admission of directly reported specific electrical values.
omission_audit.sample_size_disposition: Mechanical minimum n >= 40 remains a bound, not exact n. Linear-density and transport-specific n remain unknown because the mixed table caption does not independently establish those replicate counts.
omission_audit.geometry_disposition: SI pp.S6-S7 reports optical/SEM area measurement and CT structure analysis but no numeric cohort areas or fiber densities. Figs.S6-S7 pp.S15-S16 are surface/fracture morphology; do not replace mass-specific values with inferred raw stresses or conductivities.
omission_audit.other_specimens: Fig.S4 p.S12 reports paper electrical conductivity 909.2 S/cm, density 1.107 g/cm^3, thermal conductivity 26.92 W/m/K. These are a different form, not an alternative fiber normalization and not transferable to the eight fiber cohorts.
omission_audit.composition_disposition: Table S1 p.S9 XPS and Fig.S10 p.S20 feeding-ratio TGA are powder/functionalization characterization, not statewise final fiber mass fractions or densities. Equal concentration does not fix composition, packing or geometry.
omission_audit.main_source_gap: No local main text; historical acquisition audit records publisher access restrictions. Main-text-only numeric properties cannot be ruled absent. This audit does not repeat access attempts or certify whole-paper completeness.
